import json
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import pandas as pd
data = json.loads(Path('migration_catalog_results.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
records = data['records']
assert len(records) == 21, len(records)
summary = data['summary']
summary

rows = [{
    'original_path': r['original_path'],
    'destination': r['destination'],
    'lane': r['lane'],
    'action': r['action'],
    'suffix': r['suffix'],
    'size_bytes': r['size_bytes'],
} for r in records]
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
display(df.groupby(['lane', 'action']).size().rename('count').reset_index())
display(df.head(20))
